roadmap.title: Getting started
roadmap.description: Take the tour, try both themes, change a shortcut, and let the overlay open over a game. Everything in this guide counts only for the Steam account you are signed in to, with Steam running.

roadmap.title: Guides
roadmap.description: Open a guide and check off its steps. The step counts build up as you use guides for the games you play.

roadmap.title: Guide requests
roadmap.description: Spend your five votes on the games you want guides for, then leave them in place until one comes true.

roadmap.title: Library
roadmap.description: Quick actions around the Library, Charts and the account menu, plus two that look at how far your games are. Games you finished before installing Glyphy count.

roadmap.title: Hunting
roadmap.description: Glyphy watches the achievements you earn while it runs. Start it before your games, and these come as you play.

achievements.description: Finish the onboarding tour.
achievements.summary: Finish Glyphy's onboarding tour with the @item{Finish} button on its last step.

guide.context: The tour takes about a minute and can be replayed at any time.

steps.text: Open @loc{Settings > General} and press @item{Replay} next to Tutorial.
steps.note: On a first launch the tour offers itself, so this step is not needed.

steps.text: Press @item{Start tour} on the welcome card.
Press @item{Next} on every step, then @item{Finish} on the last one.
Do not press @item{Skip tour}. A skipped tour does not unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Open the overlay over a running game.
achievements.summary: Have Glyphy open its overlay because a Steam game started.

guide.context: @item{Preview overlay} does not count. The overlay has to open by itself for a game Glyphy detects.

steps.text: Start Glyphy and leave it running.
Launch any Steam game. The overlay opens on top of the game.
If no overlay opens, look at Automatic overlay in @loc{Settings > Overlay}. Press @item{Allow again} if the game is listed there.

achievements.description: Hide the overlay.
achievements.summary: Hide Glyphy's overlay with the Show / hide overlay shortcut or the overlay's X button.

guide.context: An overlay opened with @item{Preview overlay} counts too, so no game has to be running.

steps.text: Open the overlay: launch a Steam game, or press @item{Preview overlay} on a game's page.
Press @item{Ctrl+Alt+X}, or click the X on the overlay.
steps.note: Ctrl+Alt+X is the default Show / hide overlay shortcut. Use your own keys if you changed them.

achievements.description: Change one of the hotkeys.
achievements.summary: Save a different key combination for one of Glyphy's shortcuts.

steps.text: Open @loc{Settings > Shortcuts}.
Click a shortcut, then press a new key combination.
steps.note: The change saves by itself. Keys already used by another shortcut are not saved.

achievements.description: Use both the light and dark themes.
achievements.summary: Show Glyphy in its Light theme and in its Dark theme.

steps.text: Open @loc{Settings > General} and pick the other option under Theme: @item{Light} or @item{Dark}.

achievements.description: Open a guide.
achievements.summary: Open the guide of any achievement on the Guides page or in the overlay's Guide view.

steps.text: Open @loc{Guides}, pick a game, and select one of its achievements.

achievements.description: Check off 10 guide steps.
achievements.summary: Have 10 guide steps checked off at the same time.

guide.context: Glyphy counts the most steps you have had checked at once, across all guides. Checklist items count as steps. Steps of an achievement you already earned cannot be checked.

steps.text: In @loc{Guides}, open an achievement you have not earned yet.
Check off steps until 10 are checked in total.
steps.note: Unchecking a step and checking it again adds nothing.

achievements.description: Check off 250 guide steps.
achievements.summary: Have 250 guide steps checked off at the same time.

guide.context: This uses the same count as Step by Step: the most steps checked at once across all guides, checklist items included.

steps.text: Check off guide steps as you play, and leave them checked.
Collectible checklists add up fastest. Every item you tick counts as one step.
Do not uncheck finished guides before the unlock. Only steps that are checked right now add to the count.

achievements.description: Check off every step in one game's guide.
achievements.summary: Check off every step and checklist item of one game's guide.

guide.context: Achievements you already earned count as done. You must check at least one step yourself, so a game you have finished cannot unlock this.

steps.text: In @loc{Guides}, pick a game where you have only a few achievements left to earn.
Check off every step of each achievement you have not earned yet.
steps.note: The unlock comes with the last check.

achievements.description: Open a guide within 3 days of it being published.
achievements.summary: Open a guide no more than 3 days after its first publication.

guide.context: Only a new guide counts: an update to an older guide does not restart the 3 days. The game has to be in your library, because guides for other games cannot be opened.

steps.text: Watch for the dot on @loc{Guides} in the sidebar. It marks new or updated guides.
Open @loc{Guides > What's new} and look under For your games for a guide marked @item{New guide} from the last 3 days.
Open that guide and select one of its achievements.

achievements.description: Vote for a game to get a guide.
achievements.summary: Cast a guide request vote for any game.

steps.text: Open @loc{Guides > Requests}.
Press @item{Vote} on a game in the list.
steps.note: The Request any Steam game box finds games that are not listed yet.

achievements.description: Have all five votes in use at once.
achievements.summary: Hold five guide request votes at the same time.

guide.context: Each account has five votes, one per game. A vote can be taken back one hour after it is cast.

steps.text: In @loc{Guides > Requests}, press @item{Vote} on five different games.
steps.note: Your votes shows how many of the five are in use.

achievements.description: A game you voted for gets a guide.
achievements.estTime: when a voted game gets its guide
achievements.summary: A game gets a guide while your guide request vote for that game is still in place.

guide.context: This cannot be rushed. Guides go to the most voted games first.

steps.text: In @loc{Guides > Requests}, vote for games near the top of Most requested.
Leave those votes in place. A vote you take back no longer counts.
Wait for one of those games to get its guide. Glyphy then unlocks the achievement and gives the vote back.

achievements.description: Earn an achievement while the overlay is open.
achievements.summary: Unlock an achievement in a game while Glyphy's overlay is showing for that game.

steps.text: Start Glyphy, then launch a Steam game so the overlay opens.
Earn any achievement in that game with the overlay still on screen.
A hidden or closed overlay does not count. If you hid it, press @item{Ctrl+Alt+X} to bring it back first.

achievements.description: Earn 3 achievements within 10 minutes.
achievements.summary: Unlock 3 achievements within 10 minutes while Glyphy is running.

guide.context: The 3 achievements can come from different games. Glyphy compares the unlock times Steam records, and the overlay does not have to be open.

steps.text: With Glyphy running, earn 3 achievements with no more than 10 minutes between the first and the third.

achievements.description: Earn an achievement between 2 and 5 AM.
achievements.summary: Unlock an achievement between 02:00 and 04:59 local time while Glyphy is running.

steps.text: With Glyphy running, earn any achievement from 2:00 to 4:59 at night by your PC's clock.

achievements.description: Earn an achievement that fewer than 5% of players have.
achievements.summary: Unlock an achievement that under 5% of players have while Glyphy is running.

steps.text: Open a game from the @loc{Library} and look in the Rarity column for an achievement under 5%.
Earn that achievement with Glyphy running.

achievements.description: Reach 100% on a game while Glyphy is running.
achievements.summary: Unlock the last achievement of a game while Glyphy is running.

steps.text: In the @loc{Library}, sort by @item{Closest to 100%} to find the game you are nearest to finishing.
With Glyphy running, earn every achievement that game has left.

achievements.description: Earn an achievement in a game you hadn't played for a year.
achievements.summary: Unlock an achievement in a game last played at least 365 days earlier.

guide.context: Glyphy measures from the last time you played the game before this session, and it has to be running to see the unlock.

steps.text: In the @loc{Library} filters, tick @item{Longer ago} under Last played.
steps.note: The games left were last played over a year ago.

steps.text: Start Glyphy, then launch one of those games.
Earn an achievement before you close the game.
Get the achievement in your first session back. Playing without an unlock resets the year.

achievements.description: Have 10 games at 100%.
achievements.summary: Have 10 library games at 100% achievements.

guide.context: Games you finished before installing Glyphy count, and so do hidden games. Glyphy counts again each time the library loads.

steps.text: In the @loc{Library}, sort by @item{Closest to 100%}.
Finish games from the top of that list until 10 games are at 100%.

achievements.description: Have a game with exactly one achievement left.
achievements.summary: Have a library game with exactly one locked achievement.

guide.context: A game already in that state counts, so this can unlock as soon as your library loads.

steps.text: Earn achievements in any game until exactly one is left to earn.

achievements.description: Hide a game.
achievements.summary: Hide a game from the Library.

steps.text: In the @loc{Library}, open a game's … menu and choose @item{Hide from library}.
steps.note: To bring the game back, tick the Hidden filter and choose Show in library in the same menu.

achievements.description: Export a share image.
achievements.summary: Copy or save the share image from Charts.

steps.text: Open @loc{Charts} and press @item{Share}.
Press @item{Copy image} or @item{Save PNG}.

achievements.description: View another Steam account's library in Glyphy.
achievements.summary: Switch Glyphy to another Steam account from the account menu.

guide.context: The menu lists every account that has signed in to Steam on this PC. The other account does not need to own Glyphy.

steps.text: Click your account at the bottom of the sidebar.
Pick another account under Switch account.
steps.note: If none is listed, sign in to Steam on this PC once with a second account, then sign back in with your own.

steps.text: Switch back to your own account afterwards. While another account is shown, nothing you do in Glyphy earns achievements.

achievements.description: Look at Glyphy's own achievements in Glyphy.
achievements.summary: Open Glyphy's own game page inside Glyphy.

steps.text: In the @loc{Library}, search for Glyphy and open it.
steps.note: Glyphy does not appear among your recently played games.
